about: Sakyamuni's baked surface mended before packing (tools/t05-statue/mend.mjs, #763). Numbers are in the figure's own frame, as the anchors are: metres at the stage height, centred, foot at 0. Components are named by their number of triangles in the source below.

scraps.about: What the graft of the right hand (#514, #578) left loose round the right forearm, wrist and knee: the lining inside the forearm's shell (1834, which faces inward and was its underside from below) and twelve scraps. The body is the largest component, the hand 976, the cloth before the knee 900; those stay.

trims.about: the top edge of the cloth before the knee: a row of long thin triangles reaching up to the wrist, seen from the floor as spikes across it
and its top outer corner, a fold standing up before the forearm

press.about: the knee's outer rim under the forearm stands up in shreds of robe before bare skin: laid flat at the height the forearm's underside comes down to

tube.about: the forearm's own round underside from above the wrist into the hand: circles fitted to the shell's cross-sections (x, y of the middle, z, radius); past z 1.45 the shell is only an arch over the hand and is not followed
